owner: the Harley Street Dental Studio team
summary: You have booking, WhatsApp and awards, but dead menus and unfinished text on a Harley Street page cost credibility with high value patients.

findings.problem: About, Before and After, Prices and Dental Implants in the menu link to #. The Before and After section shows no images on the homepage.
findings.cost: Patients looking for results and prices click and get nothing.
findings.fix: Working pages with real results and prices.

findings.problem: The cookie banner shows unfilled text {title} and Manage {vendor_count} vendors, and This field is for validation purposes appears three times.
findings.cost: Template code on a premium site looks careless.
findings.fix: A clean banner and tidy forms.

findings.problem: The page claims 800+ Google reviews but shows six, each cut off. It says annual winner of awards while the list shows one win and several finalist places from 2014 to 2018.
findings.cost: Overstated proof can lose trust with careful patients.
findings.fix: Accurate, current proof and a full review wall.

findings.problem: Award logos are labelled Thank You Page, the same heading appears twice, and the patient story video shows a placeholder.
findings.cost: Small errors dilute a premium image.
findings.fix: Correct image text and working video.

redesign: Working menus, a real before and after gallery and a clear prices page.
Accurate awards, a full review wall and clean booking and WhatsApp.
